exit 0
--- stdout
Start the Liza system by setting config.mode to RUNNING in state.yaml.
This command transitions from STOPPED back to RUNNING mode.
After starting, you must manually restart agent processes to resume work.
If an unresolved HALT response survived the stop, start is rejected; run
liza resume to acknowledge the HALT while remaining STOPPED, then start normally.
Difference from resume:
- RESUME: For PAUSED or CHECKPOINT states (agents still running)
- START: For STOPPED state (agents have exited)
Use this for:
- Beginning a new work session after stopping
- Restarting the system after maintenance
- Recovering from a graceful shutdown
After running this command, restart agents manually:
LIZA_AGENT_ID=coder-1 liza agent coder &
LIZA_AGENT_ID=code-reviewer-1 liza agent code-reviewer &
Usage:
liza start [flags]
Flags:
--changed-by string identifier for audit trail (overrides LIZA_AGENT_ID env var, defaults to 'human')
-h, --help help for start
--reason string optional reason for starting the system
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
